global_rules: No loan across transaction or settlement-domain boundary unless the lender explicitly supports the exact model; this plan assumes ordinary same-transaction loans
Repay principal and fee in each asset, not a scalar USD total
Pay gas/failure costs from available native funding outside the temporary loan where chain semantics require it
Sequential reuse is modeled with state transitions; uncertain repayment is not new cash
Internal netting reduces gross transfers but does not mint new funding capacity
